one_liner: Binance offers a free, broad REST/WebSocket API with self-serve HMAC-signed API keys and an official MCP server; OAuth is partner-only.
auth_notes: Users generate an API key and secret on Binance. Private requests are signed with HMAC-SHA256. OAuth 2.0 (Binance Login) exists but is offered only to close ecosystem partners, so it is not usable for self-serve multi-user access.
access_notes: API access is free for any authenticated account. Binance charges only trading fees. A Spot testnet exists. Broker, CaaS, OMS and Connect programs need KYB or partnership, but the core APIs do not.
blocker_notes: Each user must create their own API key and secret and sign requests with HMAC. OAuth is partner-only, so multi-user use relies on user-supplied keys.

evidence.quote: For now, Binance Login (Oauth2.0), is exclusively offered to close ecosystem partners. Please reach to our business team for further information.
Binance employs **HMAC-SHA256** to authenticate API requests. When making API calls that require authentication, users must include an HMAC signature generated using their API secret key.
Binance does not charge for API access itself; commercial pricing is expressed as spot/futures trading commissions and a tiered VIP fee schedule
All endpoints return either a JSON object or array.
Free programmatic access to Binance's REST and WebSocket APIs for any authenticated account. Trading is what is billed, not connectivity.
Connect your AI agent to Binance with a single URL. Your agent can read market data, check balances, trade Spot / Margin / Convert
